Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q1 2019 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of WMT.
Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 1997 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
Revenue guidance of $46.7 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q1 2019.
Our cloud segment grew 4% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 197 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
Thank you for the question. Our gross margin expanded by 197 basis points to 55.0%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
Second question - Analyst:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
While we remain optimistic, there can be no assurance that macroeconomic headwinds won't affect demand.
